## What changed

One or two sentences.

## Why

What problem does this solve?

## How I tested

Device or emulator, the steps you tried, and the commands you ran.

## Screenshots or recording

Required for any change you can see on screen.

## Checklist

- [ ] The base branch is `develop`
- [ ] One change only, under about 300 changed lines
- [ ] `./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin` passes
- [ ] `./gradlew :intelligence:test` passes (if I changed `intelligence/`)
- [ ] No secrets, no `local.properties`, no `google-services.json`
- [ ] No emojis or long dashes in text shown in the app
- [ ] I added files by name and never used `git add .`
